sloka: स पुष्पवर्षैरवकीर्यमाणो धृतातपत्रः शितशूलपाणिः।मदोत्कटः शोणितगन्धमत्तो विनिर्ययौ दानवदेवशत्रुः ।। ६.६५.३७ ।।
transliteration: sa puṣpavarṣairavakīryamāṇo dhṛtātapatraḥ śitaśūlapāṇiḥ।madotkaṭaḥ śoṇitagandhamatto viniryayau dānavadevaśatruḥ ।। 6.65.37 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasas of loud voice, great prowess, and fearful with frightening eyes, lifted the many weapons in hand and followed on foot.
